Name: Abilities - Experience bars
Author: GukelZ
Description:
[b][color=#6aa84f][size=6]DESCRIPTION:
[/size][/color][/b][u]
[color=#b6d7a8][size=4]A mod inspirated in the "Experience Bars" mod by spacechase0.[/size][/color][/u]

That mod shows to player some informations about leveling system, like the actual player level, experience and the experience received by some action.


[color=#6aa84f][b][size=6]MOD FEATURES:
[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Shows each skill level. (Supports some mods)
[*]Shows skill actual experience.
[*]Shows skill needed experience.
[*]Shows gained experience.
[*]Configurable UI. (config.json and in-game)
[*]Level up messages.
[/list]

[color=#6aa84f][size=6][b]COMPATIBILITIES:
[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/521]Luck Skill[/url]﻿ - spacechase0
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2007]Magic[/url]﻿ - spacechase0
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/522]Cooking Skill[/url]﻿ - spacechase0
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]Love of Cooking[/url]﻿ - bblueberry 
[*]Some UI mods ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6654]Vintage UI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1310]Starry Sky[/url]﻿ ,[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/832]The Pink Interface[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery[/url]﻿) (Miscellaneous file!)
[/list]

[size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]HOW TO USE IN-GAME CONFIG:[/color]
[/b][/size]
Clicking in the Config Button you will see some options: (config key can be binded in config.json, "U" by default)

[color=#b6d7a8][b]R Button:[/b][/color] Resets all the changes (key can be binded in config.json, "Delete" by default).
[b][color=#b6d7a8]E Button[/color][color=#ffff00]:[/color][/b] Toggle the experience informations inside bars and popups.
[color=#b6d7a8][b]L Button:[/b][/color] Toggle the view of level up popup.
[color=#b6d7a8][b]B Button:[/b][/color] Toggle the view of box background.
[color=#b6d7a8][b]+ and - Buttons:[/b][/color] Adjusts the box size. (If you want to configure that via config.json, that only accepts integer numbers)
[color=#b6d7a8][b]Confirmation Button:[/b][/color] Confirms the configuration. 

To reposition the box you only need to [color=#b6d7a8][b]drag and drop[/b][/color] where you want.
The [color=#b6d7a8][b]Eye Button[/b][/color] will switch the box view. (key can be binded in config.json, "V" by default).
